data.long_meaning: In Celtic mythology, Isolt is the name of a goddess of the sea and fertility. She is often associated with the moon and is believed to have the power to heal and protect. The name Isolt carries the meaning “Goddess of the Sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
